proposals.before: When Marquis of Dongyang Zhang Xiangru vacated the post of Grand Tutor to the heir apparent,
proposals.after: When Marquis of Dongyang Zhang Xiangru was dismissed from the post of Grand Tutor to the heir apparent,
proposals.reason: Chinese 免 means dismissed/removed from office, not a voluntary vacating of the post.

proposals.before: During the revolt of Wu and Chu he commanded troops as a two-thousand-bushel minister.
proposals.after: During the revolt of Wu and Chu he commanded troops as a two-thousand-picul minister.
proposals.reason: Elsewhere in this chapter 二千石 is rendered “picul”; “bushel” is an inconsistent and less accurate translation of 石.
The colon introducing quoted speech is required; a semicolon is ungrammatical before the following quotation units.

decisions.reason: 免 after 為太子太傅 marks removal from office; “vacated” wrongly implies voluntary departure, while “was dismissed” matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 東陽侯張相如為太子太傅，免。

decisions.reason: 二千石 is the rank title; “two-thousand-bushel” is an established, accurate rendering of 石 here. Switching to “picul” is terminological preference, not correction of a semantic error.
對曰 introduces the following quoted reply; English requires a colon before that speech, not a semicolon.
